definition: II. [ פַּ֫הַד ] noun [masculine] thigh (probably loan-word (through Aramaic, otherwise = ז ) from Arabic thigh and (compare We GGN, 1893, 479 ) sub-tribe , Palmyrene פחד tribe ); — גִּידֵי פַחְדּוֺ Job 40:17 Kt the sinews of his thigh ( Qr פְּחָדָיו ), of hippopotamus.

BDB6577 | BIBLICAL HEBREW | BDB6579

II. [פַּ֫הַד] noun [masculine] thigh (probably loan-word (through Aramaic, otherwise = ז) from Arabic thigh and (compare WeGGN, 1893, 479) sub-tribe, Palmyrene פחד tribe); — גִּידֵי פַחְדּוֺ Job 40:17 Kt the sinews of his thigh (Qr פְּחָדָיו), of hippopotamus.
